issue_context.title: `python -m test` color print with and without `-j`
issue_context.body:
# Bug report

### Bug description:

`./python.exe -m test -j4` prints test results in color. `./python.exe -m test` does not. I'm assuming that the `-j` behaviour is the intended one, as that's the basic instruction in the [dev guide](https://devguide.python.org).

Having looked at the code, looks like `Regrtest::run_tests_sequentially` is a tiny bit outdated. I'll submit a PR for consideration in a bit (submitting issue to get an issue number).

[Here](https://asciinema.org/a/3UFRg91h2wLnZ3Z0I93oFQizI) is an asciinema link demonstrating the behaviour.

### CPython versions tested on:

CPython main branch

### Operating systems tested on:

macOS

<!-- gh-linked-prs -->
### Linked PRs
* gh-129364
* gh-129476
* gh-129687
* gh-130405
* gh-130406
<!-- /gh-linked-prs -->
comments:
> `./python.exe -m test -j4` prints test results in color. `./python.exe -m test` does not.

`./python.exe -m test` does print test results in colour, but it only prints success results for slow tests, so this is technically a feature. More at https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/129364#pullrequestreview-2583644554.

Anyway, this only affects 3.14 so the in practice the distinction doesn't affect bugfix backports :)
